match.input=touch: Change the columns and rows in the fields. Tap Apply to divide the area, or Cancel to stop.
match.input=*: + and - change the columns, Shift with them the rows. Enter applies, Escape cancels.

divide_refused_not_four_corners: Only an area with four corners can be divided.
divide_refused_concave: This area is not convex, so its parts would overlap or fold over.
divide_refused_in_relation: The area is a member of a relation, so it cannot be divided.
divide_refused_shared_edge: An edge of the area is shared with another way, so the parts cannot join it.
divide_refused_too_many_parts: A division has at most {max} parts.
merge_refused_conflicting_relations: These areas belong to different relations.
merge_refused_contained: One of these areas lies inside the other.
merge_refused_not_touching: These areas neither overlap nor share an edge.
merge_refused_shared_nodes_outside: A corner of one area is also used by another way, which would change.
merge_refused_tagged_nodes: A tagged point on the outline would be lost.
merge_refused_not_simple: The merged outline would not be one simple area.
merge_refused_too_many_nodes: The merged area would have too many corners.

match.input=touch: Drag a point or a midpoint, or tap to move the nearest end. Tap Apply to cut.
match.input=*: Drag a point or a midpoint, or click to move the nearest end. Enter cuts, Escape cancels.

cut_no_outline: This multipolygon has no outline to cut.
cut_refusal_not_area: Only a closed way that is an area can be cut.
cut_refusal_crossings: The line must cross the outline twice.
cut_refusal_tangent: The line only touches the outline.
cut_refusal_along_edge: The line runs along the outline.
cut_refusal_shared_edge: The line crosses an edge that another feature shares.
cut_refusal_relation_member: This area is a member of a relation that is not a multipolygon.
cut_refusal_multi_way_outline: The outline of this multipolygon is made of several ways.
cut_refusal_through_hole: The cut would cut through a hole.
cut_refusal_self_intersecting: The outline crosses itself. Fix it first.
cut_refusal_degenerate: A piece would be too small to be an area.
cut_refusal_too_many_nodes: The outline has too many corners to cut (at most 2000).
resize_hint: Drag a corner or an edge. Enter or a click outside applies, Escape cancels.
resize_refused_incomplete: Not all of it is loaded, so it cannot be resized.
resize_refused_too_thin: It is too thin: a straight line has no width to stretch.
resize_refused_too_large: Not enough of it is visible. Zoom out to resize it.
